## Overview

LRPGF06f is the registered **response-link companion** to [LRPGF06](../lrp-rli-gf-006/index.qmd) (#596), mirroring the ITT family's [LRPITT08 / LRPITT08b](../lrp-rli-itt-108/index.qmd) pair and the level family's [LRPLF06 / LRPLF06b](../lrp-rli-lf-106/index.qmd). Same children, same rows, same adjustment set, same period stacking, same priors and the same randomised term `beta_trt`; the single difference is the score mean.

Phoneme blending has ten **three-alternative forced-choice** items, so a child answering at random scores about 3.3 out of 10. The ordinary Beta-Binomial inverse-logit mean does not know that, and the LRPGF06 posterior uses the room it leaves: **15 of 161** fitted rows have posterior-mean expected proportions below one third, **10.7 %** of the row-by-draw posterior mass sits below chance, and the worst single row puts **99.8 %** of its mass there. This companion constrains the mean to $\tfrac{1}{3} + \tfrac{2}{3}\operatorname{expit}(\eta)$, so the model cannot predict below-chance performance.

**The two fits are one piece of evidence.** Because the links can disagree about the size of the effect — in the ITT pair, the only one previously fitted under both links, the items estimate halved, its 89 % interval crossed zero and the evidence label dropped a rung — neither is sufficient on its own: both plans are marked link-sensitivity-required and the release gate refuses to publish either without the other.

_Causal labelling (DAG guardrails)._ Unchanged from LRPGF06. **Only the randomised on-intervention term is causal**, and only as its **period-1 average marginal effect** — the genuinely randomised, all-untreated-baseline transition. Every other coefficient is an **adjusted association**: the child random intercept is a partial, shrunken stand-in for between-child heterogeneity and does **not** control latent general ability. Intervention sessions/dose are never conditioned on (a DAG collider). SES is excluded (not a DAG node; statistically redundant).

## Model

Beta-Binomial$(N, \mu\kappa, (1-\mu)\kappa)$ on the period post-count, $N = 10$, with the **guessing-floor score mean** $\mu = \tfrac{1}{3} + \tfrac{2}{3}\operatorname{expit}(\eta)$ and
$\eta = \alpha + \alpha_{\text{period}} + \beta_{\text{trt}}\text{OnIntervention} + \gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(\text{pre}) + \gamma_A A_{\text{std}} + \gamma_{\text{ability}}z(\text{blocks}) + \sum_{s\in\{L,E,TE\}}\gamma_s\operatorname{logit}_*(s_{\text{pre}}) + \sum_{c}\gamma_c\,z(c) + \gamma_{\text{int}}\,(A_{\text{std}} \times z(\text{blocks})) + u_{\text{child}}$, where the $z(c)$ are the standardised revised-DAG confounders hearing (HS = `hs`), speech (SP = `deapp_c`) and phonological memory (RW = `erbto`), each with a missing-indicator. Priors: shared template in `priors.py`, unchanged from LRPGF06.

![Model diagram](model_graph.png){#fig-model .lightbox fig-align="left"}

**Every reported natural-scale quantity is on this link.** The treatment marginal, the association marginals, the ROPE summary, the prior pushforward and the predicted scores all map through $\tfrac{1}{3} + \tfrac{2}{3}\operatorname{expit}(\cdot)$ rather than the raw inverse logit, because the same latent shift $\Delta\eta$ produces a smaller response-scale change under the floor link. Summarising this posterior on the ordinary link would publish an LRPGF06 number from an LRPGF06f fit.

**No intercept anchor to remap.** The level companion had to map its empirical-Bayes intercept anchor back through the link — it moved 1.1 logits. The gain family has no such anchor: the intercept prior is tiered by *scale* and left centred at zero, because a gain ANCOVA carries the outcome level in $\gamma_{\text{own}}\operatorname{logit}_*(\text{pre})$ rather than in the intercept. There is nothing to remap.

**`gamma_own` is deliberately unchanged.** Its $\operatorname{Normal}(1, 0.25)$ prior is centred on "post-logit tracks pre-logit 1:1", and under this link $\eta$ is the logit of the rescaled mean $(\mu - \tfrac{1}{3})/\tfrac{2}{3}$ rather than of $\mu$ itself, so that 1:1 reading is no longer exact. It is kept as-is because LRPITT08b — the archive-grade pair, with the same own-baseline structure — keeps it, and a link sensitivity that also moved a baseline prior would no longer isolate the link. Recorded so the assumption is visible rather than implied.
